abstract: Gemcitabine remains a mainstay of pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) treatment, while the RAS(ON) inhibitor daraxonrasib has recently demonstrated improved survival in previously treated metastatic disease. However, acquired resistance to both therapies remains a major clinical challenge. Here, we developed MTX-5-FU-Gem-miR-15a, a multimodal microRNA (miRNA)-based therapeutic, by chemically modifying tumor-suppressive miR-15a with methotrexate (MTX), 5-fluorouracil (5-FU), and gemcitabine (Gem) to combine sequence-specific gene regulation with disruption of nucleotide metabolism. MTX-5-FU-Gem-miR-15a exhibited low-nanomolar potency across five PDAC cell lines and retained activity in gemcitabine- and daraxonrasib-resistant models under vehicle-free conditions, substantially exceeding that of stoichiometrically matched free antimetabolites. Treatment induced S-phase accumulation, increased DNA damage and apoptosis, and suppressed checkpoint and survival-associated proteins, including WEE1, CHK1, YAP1, and BCL-2. Transcriptomic and proteomic analyses revealed increased DNA replication, replication-stress, and repair-associated programs, together with reduced oncogenic signaling. In gemcitabine-resistant cells, treatment restored the gemcitabine-activating enzyme dCK, reduced ABCC1 and ABCC3 expression, and suppressed resistance-associated signaling programs, indicating partial remodeling of resistance-associated pathways. MTX-5-FU-Gem-miR-15a also synergized with daraxonrasib (mean Bliss synergy score, 22.52) and activated tumor-cell-intrinsic STING-TBK1 signaling, accompanied by increased interferon stimulated gene expression and IFN-β and CXCL10 secretion. Finally, MTX-5-FU-Gem-miR-15a retained low-nanomolar potency in three patient-derived PDAC organoids and significantly suppressed metastatic tumor growth in vivo at 4 mg/kg. Together, these findings support a multimodal miRNA therapeutic strategy that combines replication-associated DNA damage, checkpoint protein suppression, and innate immune activation-associated responses to target therapeutic resistance in PDAC.
key_points_ko: 췌장관선암 세포주 5종 및 환자 유래 오가노이드 3종에서 낮은 나노몰(nM) 농도로 강력한 종양 억제 활성을 나타냈습니다.
RAS(ON) 억제제인 daraxonrasib과 병용 투여 시 높은 상조 효과(평균 Bliss 시너지 점수 22.52)를 보였습니다.
마우스 전이성 종양 모델에 4 mg/kg 용량으로 투여했을 때 전이성 종양의 성장을 유의하게 억제했습니다.
summary_ko: 본 연구는 췌장관선암(PDAC)의 항암제 내성을 극복하기 위해 다중기전 마이크로RNA(miRNA) 치료제인 MTX-5-FU-Gem-miR-15a를 개발했습니다. 이 약물은 종양 억제성 miR-15a에 메토트렉세이트(MTX), 5-플루오로우라실(5-FU), 젬시타빈(gemcitabine)을 화학적으로 결합한 합성 물질입니다. 세포 실험, 환자 유래 오가노이드(organoid) 및 동물 모델에서 기존 내성을 극복하고 종양 억제 효과를 보였습니다. 또한 daraxonrasib(다락소나십)과의 병용 효과 및 면역 활성화 반응을 확인했습니다.
title: Developing a Multimodal miR-15a Mimic to Overcome Gemcitabine and RAS(ON) Inhibitor Daraxonrasib Resistance in Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
title_ko: 췌장관선암에서 젬시타빈 및 RAS(ON) 억제제 다락소나십 내성 극복을 위한 다중기전 miR-15a 모방체 개발
